c65.verdict: All six frames show only a static dark-navy-to-rust vertical gradient with no particles, form, or structure anywhere in frame — an empty or failed-to-load render with no readable subject and no discernible motion across the loop.
c65.resembles: Mark Rothko — dusk color-field (a bare horizon gradient, but absent any generative form)

ceb.verdict: A single thin, sparse diagonal smudge of particles drifting almost imperceptibly across an otherwise empty cream field — the stroke reads as a faint calligraphic gesture but is too thin and tiny (well under 10% coverage) to hold a wall, and the motion barely changes frame to frame.
ceb.resembles: Franz Kline gestural ink stroke (a single diagonal sumi brushmark)

cy7.verdict: A thin, faint particle band tethered between two bright orbs with a slightly brighter central scatter that never resolves into a legible form; the restrained cream-on-ink palette is right, but the subject is small in the frame and the slow motion only nudges the haze rather than revealing structure.
cy7.resembles: binary star system with circumbinary dust disk

d1s.verdict: A furry grayscale oval mass with no recognizable silhouette — a textured noise blob rather than an intentional form — that dissolves into a few sparse blue specks and then near-empty black frames, so the loop ends barely visible. Motion is static-then-evaporate, abandoning what little structure existed.

e95.verdict: A washed-out field of tiny squares in mild perspective that barely separates from the cream background — restrained palette but the form is thin, low-contrast, and nearly illegible. Motion is so subtle across frames it reads as a near-static texture rather than a living loop.

ec6.verdict: Gold-on-midnight palette is restrained and gallery-appropriate, but the form is a diffuse field of glinting shards with no recognizable silhouette — handsome confetti drift rather than an intentional form, and much of the canvas stays empty black.
ec6.resembles: drifting gold-leaf flakes / gilded debris field (Klimt-esque gold fragments in suspension)

ef9.verdict: A faint vertical lattice of threads hovers center-frame but sits so dim against the black that it barely reads in 2s and occupies well under 10% of the canvas; the across-frame motion is a slow, legible drift but there is too little form to carry it.

exd.verdict: A symmetric radial particle burst with a pulsing white core — restrained icy-blue-on-black palette reads cleanly, but the form is a generic stock-VFX explosion with no emergent structure, and the breathing core is its only motion idea. Sits perilously close to the disliked radial-burst family, just in blue particles instead of red lines.
exd.resembles: dandelion clock seed head / supernova remnant burst

f0p.verdict: A thin band of RGB-split bubble-clouds creeps up from the bottom edge, leaving most of the frame empty black until the final tiles; the neon cyan/magenta palette is exactly the oversaturated pop register the wall rejects, and the overlapping blobs never resolve into a recognizable silhouette.
f0p.resembles: soap-bubble foam rendered with RGB chromatic-aberration glitch (vaporwave datamosh aesthetic)

f8e.verdict: Tangled calligraphic ribbons that never resolve into a legible form — reads as restless scribble rather than intentional shape — and the vivid neon green/magenta/cyan triad is exactly the oversaturated pop palette the wall rejects. Motion drifts acceptably but cannot rescue the muddy structure and loud color.
f8e.resembles: neon graffiti tangle / gestural ribbon scribble

fb2.verdict: A single static-noise gray square drifts slightly across frames with no emergent form, silhouette, or structure — pure granular haze, the canonical noise-blob failure mode. Motion is an imperceptible jitter that reads as a static-filled rectangle rather than intentional form.
fb2.resembles: analog TV static / CRT snow noise

fb9.verdict: A single hair-thin gold filament occupies maybe 2% of the frame, drowning in vast empty black, and the motion is barely perceptible across the six tiles — restrained palette but the form is too thin and tiny to read as anything intentional. Fails the >10%-of-frame occupancy bar for a near-empty canvas.

fdc.verdict: A restrained rust-and-gold confetti cloud in an ellipsoidal blob — palette is aged and on-brand, but the form never resolves into a recognizable silhouette and the motion is a uniform shimmer/drift with no growth or directional read. Reads as an ambient particle haze rather than an intentional form.
fdc.resembles: a dispersing swarm of autumn leaves / starling murmuration losing cohesion

gif.verdict: A drifting tangle of thin white line-segments that clumps from a scattered web into a denser ball, but never resolves into a recognizable silhouette — restrained palette, yet the form reads as a chaotic plexus blob with an odd stray dot and large dead space.

gnc.verdict: A sparse scatter of black line segments on cream reads as a restrained constructivist fragment rather than a resolved form, and the motion is so slight across frames it barely registers as a living loop. Tasteful palette and clean line-as-medium intent, but the structure is too thin and empty to hold a wall.
gnc.resembles: El Lissitzky — Proun constructivist line compositions

htb.verdict: A flat horizontal mound of gold-and-white glitter that shimmers gently but never resolves into a recognizable silhouette or structured form — pretty bokeh-haze rather than an intentional shape. The restrained warm palette helps, but it reads as a noise field of sparkles, the gallery's weakest category.
htb.resembles: sunlight glinting off rippling water (sea-surface specular glitter)

i1n.verdict: Faint, thread-thin orbital trails scattered across a mostly-empty black field — never coalesces into a readable form, and after the first tile it thins to barely-visible dim lines that fail the >10%-of-frame occupancy bar. Motion is a slow drift of sparse streaks, contemplative but with too little structure to hold the wall.

iwd.verdict: Scattered copper shards drift across a mostly empty midnight field without ever cohering into a recognizable form, and the motion thins toward near-emptiness by the final tiles rather than building structure. Palette is appropriately restrained, but the subject occupies well under 10% of frame and reads as illegible debris.
iwd.resembles: drifting orbital debris / scattered metal foil fragments

j1n.verdict: Scattered illegible cyan glyphs drifting inside faint wireframe planes with two tiny orbs read as a generic sci-fi HUD rather than a composed form; motion is a gentle data-drift but the structure stays thin and the cyan leans toward the banned neon register.
j1n.resembles: Ryoji Ikeda — data.tron / test pattern (datastream text fields)

j1r.verdict: Across all six tiles the frame is a flat, near-uniform beige haze with no discernible form, silhouette, or legible motion — only faint shifting gradients and a few stray bright specks. This reads as an empty or broken render, not a structured generative piece.

j3w.verdict: A single blown-out white blob breathing/wobbling its outline on black — no internal structure, no recognizable silhouette, just an overexposed amorphous lump; motion is a faint edge ripple that reads as formless rather than intentional.
j3w.resembles: an overexposed lunar/solar disc — closest aesthetic kin is a featureless metaball blob (Casey Reas-style noise field collapsed to one white mass)

jx5.verdict: A flat edge-on lens of gold dust that holds a restrained palette but never resolves into a recognizable silhouette — it reads as a settling pancake of particles, and the motion is so minimal the form barely evolves across the loop.

k9s.verdict: A spherical shell webbed with faint gray veins that drift and reknit across the loop, but it is so washed-out and low-contrast it nearly dissolves into the white canvas — a recognizable form starved of legibility and presence.

kf4.verdict: A bright red orb with fine threads radiating outward in a near-static breathing burst — this is exactly the banned radial red-line / Shiota red-thread family, and the saturated red palette violates the restrained-palette rule. Motion is a barely-perceptible pulse with no form development.
kf4.resembles: Chiharu Shiota — red-thread web installation (e.g. 'Uncertain Journey')

kuk.verdict: Near-empty render: only faint washed-out wisps on a blank cream field, no legible form and motion too faint to read across the tiles. Contrast is so low the piece reads as barely-there haze rather than an intentional structure.
kuk.resembles: Vija Celmins — faint graphite spiderweb on near-white ground

l5s.verdict: A single concentric ripple that breathes slowly in and out — restrained gray-on-cream palette and unhurried motion, but the form is a plain target pattern with thin structure and little to read beyond expanding rings.
l5s.resembles: concentric water ripples from a raindrop (circular interference pattern)

lam.verdict: A flat red color-field with frayed fur-like black fringe at top and bottom that barely changes across the loop — no recognizable silhouette or emergent structure, and the near-static, hovering motion gives nothing to read. The pure vivid red also reads as oversaturated rather than aged/restrained.
lam.resembles: Mark Rothko — red-on-black color field (here degraded into a frayed haze rather than a composed form)

ldo.verdict: A dense tangle of crimson tubes reads as one coherent rounded mass with calm, slow breathing motion, but the oversaturated vivid-red palette violates the restrained-earth-tone gate and the red-thread knot evokes the retired Shiota family.

lhc.verdict: A small white metaball pulses and divides while a faint chromatic-fringed ring orbits it, but the form stays amorphous and never resolves into a recognizable silhouette; the morph motion is calm yet the subject floats tiny in a vast empty frame.
lhc.resembles: a dividing cell under dark-field microscopy (mitosis / cytokinesis)

loo.verdict: A few isometric voxel cubes with a neon-green glow block shuffling positions reads as a corporate loading-logo, not a contemplative form; the saturated green and small subject lost in empty black work against the gallery's aged, restrained aesthetic.

luw.verdict: A tiny ember-like wisp drifts and dissipates across a vast empty dusk canvas, occupying well under 10% of frame; the restrained palette is fine but the form is small, illegible, and reads as a guttering flame rather than an intentional structure, with motion that fragments into sparse streaks instead of resolving.
luw.resembles: a guttering candle flame / wisp of smoke (will-o'-the-wisp)

mw3.verdict: Thin, scattered gold-and-white flecks drift in vague vertical streaks with no coherent silhouette or emergent form — restrained gold-on-midnight palette is right, but it's ambient sparkle-haze, and the slow downward drift never resolves into a readable structure.
mw3.resembles: deep-sea marine snow drifting through a dark water column

nss.verdict: Two tiny ink-and-rust dots tethered by a thin line drift slowly across a near-empty cream field, occupying well under 10% of the frame — restrained palette and unhurried motion can't rescue a structure this thin and small.

nza.verdict: A single flat woven grid of tiny squares that simply swings/rotates edge-on through the loop — the palette is nicely aged cream-on-sage, but the form is thin and one-dimensional, reading as a rotating screen mesh rather than a developed structure. The motion is a slow turn but the panel flattens to a near-empty sliver, so the piece never resolves into a memorable form.

o0i.verdict: An illegible tangled knot of ribbons in a loud neon palette (vivid cyan, lime, hot pink) that never resolves into a recognizable silhouette, and the final frames degrade into glitchy RGB-split mush; the colors fight the form rather than serving it.
o0i.resembles: Cy Twombly's looping scribble paintings (e.g. 'Bacchus') rendered as a 3D multicolored yarn ball

om7.verdict: A single cream amoeba-shape drifting slowly across a tilted dark trapezoid reads as thin and forgettable — restrained ink-and-bone palette is right, but the form is one undifferentiated blob with no legible silhouette, sitting flat on a washed-out backdrop. Motion is appropriately unhurried but the composition never resolves into an intentional form.

omj.verdict: Banned radial red-line/thread-burst — bright crimson filaments radiating from a central glowing cone, the Shiota red-thread family in disguise; motion is near-static across all six frames with no readable development.

p2x.verdict: A single textured gold orb ringed by a few saturated red satellite dots in slow orbit reads as a thin planet/atom diagram rather than a developed form; the central-orb-with-red-satellites structure also flirts with the banned Shiota radial-red family, and the vivid red is too pop against the restrained palette goal.

p3f.verdict: A single thin vertical filament of white-and-cyan dots stranded in a vast black canvas, occupying well under 10% of the frame; the form is too sparse to read as intentional and the motion barely changes across the loop, so it feels static and near-empty rather than contemplative.
p3f.resembles: a single bioluminescent siphonophore strand drifting in deep ocean

p5w.verdict: A small fuzzy cream orb that blows out toward uniform white over the loop, losing its faint speckled texture rather than resolving into any form; the motion is just a slow brightening swell with no readable structure.
p5w.resembles: an overexposed long-exposure photo of a single dim star / out-of-focus bokeh dot

p5x.verdict: A field of olive-and-white blobs drifting and clustering with no recognizable silhouette or emergent form; the motion is aimless jitter rather than contemplative growth, and the yellow-green reads too vivid for the gallery palette.
p5x.resembles: fluorescence microscopy of a cell culture

p8t.verdict: A vertical grainy column of white particles that reads more as flickering static/chalk-dust than an intentional form; the restrained ink-and-bone palette is right, but the silhouette stays muddy and the per-frame churn feels more like noise than contemplative growth.

p9y.verdict: A tilted rectangular plane of dense, uniform TV-static grain with faint magenta speckle — no silhouette, no emergent structure, and the six frames are nearly identical so there is no legible motion. This is the formless-noise failure mode on a perspective quad.
p9y.resembles: analog television static / CRT snow noise

pa2.verdict: Two fuzzy grayscale blobs of static-like grain float in a vast empty black frame with no recognizable silhouette, and across the loop they only shimmer and drift faintly — formless noise-cloud, not an intentional form. Exactly the nebula-haze failure mode the gallery rejects.
pa2.resembles: a smudged long-exposure telescope frame of two distant galaxies (Hubble fuzzy-smudge)

pyb.verdict: An illegible tangle of straight line segments in loud primary red/blue/yellow that never resolves into a coherent form, and the across-frame motion only reshuffles the scribble rather than revealing structure. Loud oversaturated palette plus formless wireframe mush.
pyb.resembles: Naum Gabo linear construction wireframe (but scribbled and color-noisy)

r5j.verdict: Opens on a promising structured field of warm-gold horizontal striations, but the loop simply disperses it into a sparse, cool-white starfield scatter with no recognizable silhouette — the strong early state decays into forgettable formless speckle.
r5j.resembles: Yayoi Kusama — Infinity Mirrored Room (The Souls of Millions of Light Years Away)

rtd.verdict: A static horizontal band of golden granular noise with no discernible form, silhouette, or structural motion — the frames are near-identical, reading as TV-static haze rather than an intentional form. Despite the on-brand gold-on-ink palette, this is the formless-noise auto-weak case with no legible subject.
rtd.resembles: untuned analog TV static / CRT snow

to8.verdict: A dense bone-colored cloud dissolving downward into sparse scattered dots — restrained palette, but the top reads as a structureless blob with no recognizable silhouette, and the near-frozen frame-to-frame motion gives little sense of intentional falling or growth. Subject also hugs a narrow central column with large empty black margins.
to8.resembles: Daniel Arsham — eroding figure shedding as falling sand

ty4.verdict: A restrained dusk palette (ash, cream, smoke) is the only real strength; the central form is a fuzzy woven blob with no recognizable silhouette paired with a generic soft moon disc, and the slow drift never resolves it into intentional structure.
ty4.resembles: Hiroshi Sugimoto — moon over a tonal seascape

ucz.verdict: Generic angular wireframe 'plexus' network of triangulated clusters on black that drifts and re-links but never resolves into one coherent silhouette; restrained white-on-ink palette helps, but the form reads as scattered and unremarkable.
ucz.resembles: classic three.js 'Plexus' constellation network (interlinked point-and-line nebula)

uqw.verdict: A tangled wireframe box of crossing red/yellow/blue/white line segments that never resolves into a legible form; the loud primary palette reads as oversaturated and chaotic rather than restrained, and the slight inter-frame rotation only reshuffles the clutter.
uqw.resembles: early Frieder Nake / A. Michael Noll plotter-line abstraction

v0t.verdict: A loose scatter of cream-to-gold square sprites drifting gently on black — palette is restrained and the slow warm-shift motion is contemplative, but the particles never cohere into a recognizable silhouette or field, reading as thin, formless confetti.

v8i.verdict: A spiky orb of bright lines radiating from a central core that barely moves across the loop — this is the banned radial line-burst family ('never do these radial red line again'), and the neon red/blue/yellow/purple palette is exactly the oversaturated pop-art look the gate forbids. Form is a static pincushion, not an emergent structure.
v8i.resembles: Chiharu Shiota — radial red-thread burst (in multicolor disguise)

vg3.verdict: A restrained bone/sand palette is appealing, but the form is thin and illegible — a faint drifting square wireframe over a horizontal dust-smear with a vague dark blob that gently pulses; the motion is unhurried but never resolves into a readable form.
vg3.resembles: Vija Celmins — faint graphite field studies

vs1.verdict: A tiny white form drifts and morphs centered in a vast black void, occupying well under 10% of the frame so the shape never resolves into a readable silhouette; the slow wobble is calm but there is too little structure to hold a wall. The fatal flaw is scale — a small subject lost in empty canvas.

vtg.verdict: A flat, grain-noise-textured quad slowly tumbling from tilted-square to diamond — restrained ink palette is fine, but the form is a trivial rotating plane with no emergent structure or silhouette, reading as a sandpaper swatch rather than a generative form.
vtg.resembles: Vantablack-coated monolith / a sheet of dark sandpaper

wfg.verdict: A dusk-gradient sky (midnight-to-rust, nicely restrained palette) but the particles are sparse, barely-visible dust that never resolves into any form; motion is imperceptible across the loop, reading as a near-empty ambient haze rather than a structured field.
wfg.resembles: faint Milky Way dust over a desert horizon at twilight

wox.verdict: A horizontal cream-on-ink particle band hovers over a contour-lined terrain, but it reads as a formless dust haze with no recognizable silhouette; the breathing motion is gentle yet the form never resolves into anything intentional.
wox.resembles: Sahara haboob dust storm rolling over dunes

wyz.verdict: A blown-out white mass fills nearly the entire frame with only blurry brown gradient edges visible; there is no legible form, silhouette, or structure, just an overexposed slab that barely shifts across the six tiles.

x0l.verdict: Opens on a legible spiky radial burst (frame 1) but the motion is pure dissipation — the form scatters into uniform full-frame speckle with no silhouette, so the settled state is formless static grain. The decay-into-noise trajectory is exactly the gallery's noise-blob failure mode.
x0l.resembles: a dandelion seed-head dispersing in wind

x6y.verdict: A pretty restrained dusk-to-rust gradient, but the particles are a near-invisible scatter of faint specks that never resolve into any form and occupy well under 10% of frame; motion is imperceptible drift with nothing to read.
x6y.resembles: Mark Rothko — dusk color field (the gradient dominates; the particles read as faint atmospheric dust)

xuh.verdict: A single thin vertical thread of green-flecked particles hangs in a vast black field, occupying far under 10% of the frame; the form barely reads and the motion across tiles is near-static, so it registers as a faint streak rather than a composition.
xuh.resembles: The Matrix digital-rain column (single isolated strand)

xv9.verdict: An amorphous oval of soft defocused bokeh dots that drifts and pulses gently but never resolves into any silhouette or structure — exactly the formless glowing-blob failure mode, and the bright blues edge toward un-restrained. Motion is unhurried but there's no form to read.

y2k.verdict: A single thin calligraphic brushstroke on cream — restrained duotone is on-aesthetic, but one hair-thin line occupies far under 10% of the frame and the motion across frames is so slight it barely reads as alive. Thin, forgettable structure rather than a wall piece.
y2k.resembles: Brice Marden — Cold Mountain calligraphic line drawings

yik.verdict: Three soft defocused orbs (gold + two lavender) drift almost imperceptibly on a muted tan plane — restrained palette, but the form is just blurred blobs with no recognizable silhouette and near-zero legible motion. Reads as ambient haze, the gallery's noise-blob failure mode.
yik.resembles: Mark Rothko color-field (soft luminous rectangles) — but without the compositional tension

ym5.verdict: A small earth-toned knot of angular cream-and-brown shards clustered center-frame in restrained palette, but the silhouette reads as muddy illegible tangle rather than a recognizable form, and motion across the loop is barely perceptible so it sits inert in a mostly empty canvas.
ym5.resembles: a bird's-nest tangle of dried brushwood

yqu.verdict: A vertical skein of white threads is legible as lines-not-points with a restrained ink-and-bone palette, but the form never resolves past an indistinct tangled rectangle; motion is appropriately unhurried (slow shedding of particles at the crown) yet too static to earn the column a clear silhouette.
yqu.resembles: Cy Twombly — looping white-on-blackboard scribble drawings

yy3.verdict: A flat horizontal mat of cubes ripples in a low wave, but the form reads as a shapeless shimmering carpet with no silhouette, and the loud primary red/yellow/blue palette is exactly the vivid pop-art register the wall rejects.
yy3.resembles: a field of confetti / Carlos Cruz-Diez chromatic floor

z3q.verdict: A flat golden granular sand-field fills the lower frame with only two faint gray vertical wisps that barely register as form; motion is near-static with negligible change across the loop, reading as textured noise rather than an intentional shape.
z3q.resembles: Vija Celmins — Night Sky / sand-grain field studies

zrd.verdict: A clustered metaball blob of overlapping spheres that reads as a raspberry-like clump but never resolves into an intentional silhouette; motion is barely perceptible across the loop and the hot-magenta fill is an oversaturated neon palette the gallery explicitly bans.

zs1.verdict: A featureless brown mound with sparse dust-speck particles under a cream sky, breathing almost imperceptibly across the loop — the restrained duotone palette is right but the form is a thin, muddy blob with no recognizable silhouette and motion too subtle to read.
zs1.resembles: Hiroshi Sugimoto — Seascapes (duotone horizon), but collapsed into a shapeless dune

zst.verdict: A faint speck of particles floats in a vast empty dusk-to-rust gradient, occupying barely 2% of the frame with no legible form; motion is an almost imperceptible drift that never resolves into structure. Restrained palette can't rescue a near-empty render of an illegible smudge.
zst.resembles: a distant starling murmuration seen as a faint smudge at dusk
